title: Salty Seabreeze | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Salty Seabreeze is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Salty Seabreeze – Pet-Friendly Coastal Retreat on 30ASalty Seabreeze is a pet-friendly, three-story home with 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, comfortably accommodating up to 11 guests. Nestled in the charming Seabreeze Cottages community along scenic 30A, the home is just steps from the community pool, sugar-white sand, and the emerald waters of the Gulf Coast. Spend your days walking along the shoreline, collecting seashells, or enjoying the vibrant coastal culture nearby.Your SpaceThe 2nd level living area is bright and airy, with natural light streaming through large windows and a soothing palette of whites and light grays. The fully equipped kitchen includes a coffee maker, Keurig, microwave, and quartz countertops with a breakfast bar for casual meals. The dining area seats eight, perfect for family dinners or sharing fresh local seafood from nearby markets. A washer and dryer are available for added convenience.Outdoor SpacesStep onto the covered balcony to sip morning coffee or an evening cocktail while feeling the coastal breeze and enjoying partial Gulf views. Just steps from the home, the community pool and grill make it easy to gather and unwind. Take a short stroll to the beach, where you can swim, paddleboard, or simply watch the sun rise over the water.Sleeping Arrangements1st Level, Primary Bedroom: King bed, TV, en suite bath with tub and walk-in shower, direct patio access1st Level, Guest Bedroom: 3 Twin beds, TV, private bath2nd Level, Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen beds, TV, shared hallway bath3rd Level, Secondary Bedroom: King bed, TV, private balcony, private bath with walk-in showerLocal Experiences & Nearby AttractionsSalty Seabreeze puts you close to the heart of 30A’s coastal lifestyle. Explore Alys Beach and enjoy live music at Shades or fresh seafood at George’s. Shop for local art and crafts at Peddlers Pavilion or stroll through Rosemary Downtown, stopping at The Pearl or Sugar Shack for unique bites and treats. Grab a coffee at Idyll Proper or play a round of arcade games at Attycat’s. For groceries, casual dining, or sweets, Watersound Towncenter offers Publix, Ambrosia, Village Market, Nigels, Sweet Henriettas, and The Big Chill. Guests can enjoy kayaking, paddleboarding, or cycling along 30A, making every day an authentic Gulf Coast experience.Activities and Adventures with XplorieYour stay includes one ticket per day, per activity with Xplorie, valued at over $800 per night. Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise, enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, try Black Light Mini Golf, and take scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure.Other things to note:* Snowbird Friendly!* Parking for 2 cars.* Dog Friendly: Up to 2 dogs (max 30 lbs) allowed. Non-refundable pet fee applies. Contact us if bringing a dog. See rental policies for details.An initial starter kit of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
